name: task_cancel
description: Cancel one or more still-running asynchronously spawned subagent tasks (from task_spawn). Terminates the subagent process and fills its result slot with a 'cancelled' terminal result, so later task_wait/task_status reports cancelled instead of hanging; you must still collect that cancelled result with `task_wait` or `task_status` before it can be integrated. Use to abandon a stuck or no-longer-needed background subagent instead of repeatedly calling task_wait.

task_ids.description: Array of async subagent task ids (from task_spawn) to cancel.

reason.description: Optional reason for canceling these tasks.
